Dig pipes and manage water flow through increasingly intricate underground networks to prevent leaks and ensure steady supply. The puzzle-based core mechanic challenges players to rotate and connect pipe segments under time pressure while navigating tight layouts. Strategic problem solving and quick adjustments are key to completing each level and safeguarding precious water resources in an urban environment.  

Key Features

• Pipe rotation connection system  
• Time-limited puzzle stages  
• Progressive network complexity  
• Leak prevention challenge mode  
• Urban water supply theme

pages.title: Pop Fruit
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description:
Pop bursting mechanics drive this colorful puzzle experience as players connect matching fruit icons to clear the board. Strategic chain reactions enhance scoring while timed levels challenge quick thinking and precision. Each new round ramps up complexity with varied fruit patterns and limited swaps for puzzle completion.

Key Features

• Match-3 chain reaction system  
• Swipe-based fruit connection controls  
• Progressive level difficulty scaling  
• Time-limited puzzle challenges  
• Vibrant fruit icon visuals

pages.title: Spin Thru
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Spin clockwise to navigate through complex rotating obstacles in a fast-paced reflex test. Players control a spinning disc that must time its moves precisely to avoid hazards and progress through increasingly challenging circular levels. Mastering momentum and timing is key to surviving as the difficulty ramps up with tighter gaps and faster spins.

Key Features

• Precision timing spin mechanic  
• Reflex-based obstacle navigation  
• Increasingly complex circular levels  
• Momentum management challenges  
• Abstract minimalist visual design

pages.title: Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description:
Snack on diverse ASMR dishes by interacting with vivid mukbang setups, triggering satisfying sound effects to enhance immersion. Players control food selections and eating rhythms while managing a quirky character’s eating pace. The challenge revolves around balancing satisfying mukbang timing with character enjoyment in a cozy casual environment.

Key Features

• Interactive eating rhythm control  
• Sound-triggered ASMR effects  
• Character mood management  
• Progression through meal variety  
• Casual mukbang dining setting

pages.title: ASMR Beauty Clinic
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description:
Manage a serene beauty clinic by customizing ASMR treatment sessions to relax clients deeply. Use interactive controls to select and apply soothing facial and scalp care techniques, progressing through levels with increasingly intricate client requests. The gameplay focuses on rhythm and timing to maximize relaxation effects in a calming spa environment.

Key Features

• Interactive ASMR treatment controls  
• Client relaxation timing mechanic  
• Progressive session complexity  
• Customizable spa tools system  
• Calm clinic atmosphere simulation

pages.title: Picture by Pieces
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Arrange scattered puzzle pieces to reveal intricate pixel art images while managing time limits for each stage. Players rotate and place geometric shapes using a drag-and-drop system to complete each puzzle’s picture. The challenge builds with increasingly complex designs and segmented areas, rewarding precision and spatial awareness as you progress through a gallery of vibrant artworks.

Key Features

• Shape rotation and placement mechanic  
• Drag-and-drop puzzle controls  
• Increasing puzzle complexity levels  
• Time limit based stage progression  
• Pixel art visual style

pages.title: Aha World Dream Town
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Mix and match colorful pieces to create whimsical scenes filled with quirky characters and charming buildings. This puzzle game challenges players to arrange dream-like elements on a vibrant grid, encouraging strategic icon placement to complete unique levels. As you progress, newly unlocked decorations add fresh variety to each imaginative town you build.

Key Features

• Pattern matching puzzle mechanics  
• Icon placement grid control  
• Level-based progression system  
• Unlockable decorative elements  
• Whimsical fantasy town setting
